fusions.name: Jumped the Break
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 11 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flash Point
fusions.desc: Sends a spark that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Scorched Wake
fusions.desc: Leaves a line of flame 5 tiles long in front of you for 5 seconds. It deals 4 damage to each enemy that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Friction Heat
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
